svg.aria-label: Context parallelism for KDA at CP2. The all-to-all version exchanges the projections, about 10 times wider than the hidden state. The all-gather version exchanges the hidden state and each rank projects only its own heads, sending about 5 times fewer bytes across ranks.
svg.text: Two ways to go from sequence shards to head shards before the KDA kernel.
Both send outputs back to sequence order with one all-to-all afterwards.
Exchange the projections, about 10× wider than the hidden state.

rect.style: transform-origin: 620px 161px; animation: k1 8.0s linear infinite; transform: scaleX(0);

text.style: fill:#2f6fc6; animation: k2 8.0s linear infinite; opacity: 0;

svg.text: Exchange the 4,096-wide hidden state; each rank projects only its own heads.

rect.style: transform-origin: 620px 486px; animation: k17 8.0s linear infinite; transform: scaleX(0);

text.style: fill:#2f6fc6; animation: k18 8.0s linear infinite; opacity: 0;

svg.text: All-gather sends ~5× fewer bytes into each KDA layer at CP2
1M step: 335 s → 307 s (−8%), faster over both TCP and EFA
